intent: Calm, human, evidence-legible interface. Historical Project-first prototypes are referenced only for restraint and readability, never for IA or pixels.

hierarchy.first_screen: One Person-first greeting, one 3-item focus summary, two equal domains, one conditional safety question.
hierarchy.progressive_disclosure: Evidence and lifecycle details live in keyboard-dismissible dialogs; the primary screen does not turn into a Project dashboard.
hierarchy.identity: Content identity is always conveyed with text labels, not color alone.

responsive.1280x1024: Three priority cards in one row; all dialog actions remain reachable.
responsive.1160x768: Cards retain hierarchy without clipping; navigation remains labeled.
responsive.700x760: Rail condenses, priority cards stack, buttons wrap, and no essential action becomes hover-only or horizontally hidden.

accessibility.motion: prefers-reduced-motion is honored; the visible low-motion preview uses the same non-vestibular transition contract for testability.
accessibility.contrast: Text labels, border and icon changes accompany all color states.

forbidden_visuals: full-page static image masquerading as UI
